violation_type.title: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics (26 TAC §746.1309(f))
violation_type.short_title: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics
violation_type.typical_finding: One employee was lacking five hours of training.  The training can be in the following areas (746.1309 (f).

finding_variants.text: One employee was lacking five hours of training.  The training can be in the following areas (746.1309 (f).
The director admitted that none of the staff are trained in the topic of caring for children with special needs.

Three caregivers did not have the required HASA training certificates available for review.     1. Emergency preparedness  2. Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases.   3. Administering medication  4. Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction.  5. Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
Based on external documentation, caregiver hired on 2/21/2022 did not receive training in biting to meet the needs of the classroom with biters.
Based on external documentation and follow up inspection, operation has not trained staff on how to handle children who bite while in their care.
Five out of six staff files reviewed were missing handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous material training.
